scientific_boundaries: Capillary discharge and Stark-based density diagnostics are experimental; neutral gas is OpenFOAM, meter-scale extension and beam acceptance are not newly demonstrated.
FLASH is actual RF LINAC film dosimetry plus MCNP6; no new laser source, biological FLASH endpoint, photoneutron or shielding certification.
12.7percent is scan-family mean ratio; source-particle doses are not pulse doses; pulse timing numbers are algebraic inferences.
Printed phantom/voxel units, low-density diagnostic range, tail/penumbra and normalization gaps explicitly retained.
No physics solver, dose calibration, beam, animal or clinical experiment rerun.
